text:
Alex Chen: Hey finance — quick one. Took a last-minute rail from Paddington to MAN for a client meeting yesterday. Only have an Apple Wallet boarding pass screenshot and the QR code, no PDF/itemized ticket. Can I expense this? attaching wallet-pass.png

Maria Gomez: Hi @Alex — per policy we usually need an itemized receipt showing merchant + VAT. In practice if you can upload the Apple Wallet pass *and* the bank card transaction line that includes the merchant name, we can make an exception for domestic rail. Please add the bank txn screenshot.

Alex Chen: Uploaded: apple-wallet-pass.jpg and bank-tx-0426.png (see thread). The merchant shows as "FirstClassRail" on the card line, amount matches.

Finance Bot: Expense draft created — EXP-2026-0426-77. Please confirm manager approval to process.

Maria Gomez: Thanks. If manager signs off we'll reimburse the fare. Can you also confirm trip reason (client name) so we tag expense correctly?

Alex Chen: Client: NiftyAnalytics — sales kickoff. Trip reason added to the expense notes.

Alex Chen: @Linda Park tagging for manager approval

Linda Park: I approve — urgent meeting with NiftyAnalytics, fine to reimburse. Approved per policy exception. :white_check_mark:

Simon Patel: Quick note from finance leadership — we're okay accepting wallet/pass + bank txn + manager approval for domestic rail (no VAT receipt) going forward. I'll add to the FAQ.

Maria Gomez: Great, thanks everyone. @Alex I'll mark EXP-2026-0426-77 as manager-approved and process in the next run. Please expect reimbursement on the next card-run. Closing when transaction posts. :money_with_wings:

Alex Chen: Thanks team! :pray:
